highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update and a refreshed HarfBuzzSharp binding surface.
highlights_body: Review the HarfBuzzSharp compatibility changes below before moving existing text-shaping code to this preview.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz combining-class and flag members updated
breaking.body: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is renamed to CCC132, and GlyphFlags.Defined is removed. Update code to use CCC132 and combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 for preview consumers.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opens the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update and regenerated HarfBuzzSharp bindings.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 renderer.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It also refreshes HarfBuzzSharp generation from the bundled native source.
